'''Shimotsuke no Iwashiro''' (下毛野 石代) was a Japanese noble active from the late {{ill|Asuka period|en|Asuka period|qid=Q210688|lt=Asuka period}} to the early {{ill|Nara period|en|Nara period|qid=Q189178|lt=Nara period}}. He held the Rank of [[Junior Fifth Rank|Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade]] and served as [[Kyōshiki|Governor of the Left Capital]].

== Career ==
In the first year of the [[Taihō (Japan)|Taihō era]] (701), upon the death of the [[:en:Sadaijin|Minister of the Left]] {{ill|Tajihi no Shima|ja|多治比嶋}}, Iwashiro delivered a eulogy on behalf of the entire court while holding the Rank of [[Junior Seventh Rank|Junior Seventh Rank, Lower Grade]]. In the fourth year of {{ill|Keiun|en|Keiun|qid=Q428753|lt=Keiun}} (707), following a petition by his kinsman {{ill|Shimotsukeno no Komaro|ja|下毛野古麻呂}}, Iwashiro’s family name was changed from {{ill|Shimotsukeno clan|ja|下毛野氏|lt=Shimotsukeno clan}} (Shimotsukeno no Ason) to Shimotsukeno no Kawachi no Ason.

At the end of the [[Wadō era]] (715), Iwashiro was promoted from [[Junior Sixth Rank|Junior Sixth Rank, Upper Grade]] to [[Junior Fifth Rank|Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade]] by an exceptional three-Rank promotion. During the reign of {{ill|Empress Genshō|en|Empress Genshō|qid=Q235343|lt=Empress Genshō}}, he served as [[Kyōshiki|Governor of the Left Capital]]. In the fourth year of {{ill|Yōrō|en|Yōrō|qid=Q1373061|lt=Yōrō}} (720), when a rebellion by the {{ill|Emishi|en|Emishi|qid=Q932574|lt=Emishi}} in {{ill|Mutsu Province|en|Mutsu Province|qid=Q907389|lt=Mutsu Province}} led to the death of the [[Mutsu Azechi|Inspector of Mutsu]], {{ill|Kamitsukeno no Hirohito|ja|上毛野広人}}, Iwashiro was appointed Vice Commander of the expeditionary force under General {{ill|Tajihi no Agatamori|ja|多治比縣守}}.

== Court Positions ==
According to the ''[[Shoku Nihongi]]'':
* [[Taihō (Japan)|Taihō]] 1 (701), 7th month, 21st day: Held the Rank of [[Junior Seventh Rank|Junior Seventh Rank, Lower Grade]].
* {{ill|Keiun|en|Keiun|qid=Q428753|lt=Keiun}} 4 (707), 3rd month, 22nd day: Changed name from Shimotsukeno no Ason to Shimotsukeno no Kawachi no Ason.
* Unknown date: Promoted to [[Junior Sixth Rank|Junior Sixth Rank, Upper Grade]].
* [[:en:Wadō|Wadō]] 8 (715), 1st month, 10th day: Promoted to [[Junior Fifth Rank|Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade]] (special three-Rank promotion).
* Unknown date: Appointed [[Kyōshiki|Governor of the Left Capital]].
* {{ill|Yōrō|en|Yōrō|qid=Q1373061|lt=Yōrō}} 4 (720), 9th month, 29th day: Appointed Vice Commander for the expedition against the Emishi.
